name: Artisan
description: Coding agent harness — sessions on runner directories, threads, subagents, skills.

endpoints.name: createSession
endpoints.description: Creates a session bound to a runner directory (any type; type=directory is the default webapp kind). Optional opening message runs immediately.

endpoints.name: listSessions
endpoints.description: Sessions, newest first. Defaults to type=directory (webapp list); ?type= picks another, ?all=1 disables the filter.

endpoints.name: getSession
endpoints.description: Session + flat messages + usage + plan + running flag. Works for any session type.

endpoints.name: getInspectRound
endpoints.description: Inspector: the exact request (system prompt, history, tool schemas) sent for one round. Kept 3 days, then 404 { error: 'expired' }.

endpoints.name: listMicrovms
endpoints.description: Dispatch microvms usable as a session runner (address them as `microvm:<identifier>`).

endpoints.name: createMicrovm
endpoints.description: Boots a new microvm through dispatch. Optional name becomes the identifier.

endpoints.name: listRunnerDir
endpoints.description: Lists a directory on a runner or microvm (directory picker). `path` may start with ~.

endpoints.name: makeRunnerDir
endpoints.description: mkdir -p an absolute path on a runner or microvm.

endpoints.name: updateSession
endpoints.description: Renames and/or switches the session's model.

endpoints.name: sendMessage
endpoints.description: Sends a user message and starts a run (same as the WS send frame). Stream frames over the workspace WS.

endpoints.name: newThread
endpoints.description: /new — closes the current thread and opens a fresh one; clears the plan.

endpoints.name: compactSession
endpoints.description: /compact — summarizes the conversation into the thread summary and starts a new thread.

endpoints.name: abortSession
endpoints.description: Aborts a running session loop.

endpoints.name: workspaceWs
endpoints.description: One WS per workspace. Client frames: join/leave {sessionId}, send {sessionId,text}, answer/cancel {sessionId,askId}. Server frames all carry sessionId: joined, message, run_start, round_start, thinking_delta, delta, message_done, tool_start/output/result, ask_user, ask_resolved, status, plan, usage, compaction_done, session_renamed, error, done.

endpoints.name: listDirectories
endpoints.description: Distinct runner+directory+space combos the workspace has sessions on.

endpoints.name: createAgent
endpoints.description: Creates a custom agent (sub_agent | persona | collaborator | any custom type).

endpoints.name: getAgent
endpoints.description: One agent including its instruction (system prompt).

endpoints.name: listTools
endpoints.description: The tools an agent can be allowed to use (name + description).

endpoints.name: listAgents
endpoints.description: Agents in a space (directory agents included — they are auto-created per runner+directory).

endpoints.name: updateAgent
endpoints.description: Updates any agent field (instruction, model, tools allowlist, tags, pinned dir).

endpoints.name: deleteAgent
endpoints.description: Deletes an agent.

endpoints.name: createSkill
endpoints.description: Creates a skill. `scope` = one availability mode: global | agents | spaces | types, each (except global) either `all` or a list of ids (agent ids, space ids, or agent types).

endpoints.name: listSkills
endpoints.description: All skills in the workspace with their availability scope (?content=1 includes the content).

endpoints.name: getSkill
endpoints.description: One skill including its content.

endpoints.name: updateSkill
endpoints.description: Updates a skill's name, description, content or availability scope.

endpoints.name: deleteSkill
endpoints.description: Deletes a skill.

endpoints.name: getGlobalInstruction
endpoints.description: The workspace's global instruction — base rules added to every agent's system prompt.

endpoints.name: setGlobalInstruction
endpoints.description: Sets the global instruction (max 20,000 characters; empty clears it). Applies from each agent's next run.

endpoints.name: listMcpServers
endpoints.description: MCP server configs (remote http/sse). Config only — not yet offered to agents.

endpoints.name: getMcpServer
endpoints.description: One MCP server config.

endpoints.name: createMcpServer
endpoints.description: Registers an MCP server. Name is unique and prefixes tool names (mcp__<name>__<tool>); header values may use <ENV_NAME> placeholders. Availability: global, agents, spaces, directories or agent types.

endpoints.name: updateMcpServer
endpoints.description: Updates an MCP server's name, url, transport, headers, enabled flag or availability.

endpoints.name: deleteMcpServer
endpoints.description: Deletes an MCP server config.

endpoints.name: previewMcpImport
endpoints.description: Parses an mcpServers JSON paste (VS Code / Claude Desktop / Cursor) without saving. stdio entries are skipped.

endpoints.name: importMcpServers
endpoints.description: Creates one MCP server per entry of an mcpServers JSON paste, all with the given availability. Existing names are reported as conflicts.

endpoints.name: listMemories
endpoints.description: Memories. With sessionId: what that session's agent sees (organization + directory + own + session; sub-agents inherit their caller's). Without: every memory in the workspace.

endpoints.name: createMemory
endpoints.description: Creates a memory at a level. code_directory needs directoryId, self needs agentId (persona/collaborator), session needs sessionId. Titles are unique per level and owner.

endpoints.name: updateMemory
endpoints.description: Renames a memory and/or replaces its content.

endpoints.name: deleteMemory
endpoints.description: Deletes a memory.

endpoints.name: listModels
endpoints.description: Proxied TwoRoute /v1/models — the model picker source.

endpoints.name: listRunners
endpoints.description: Proxied Dispatch runners, online only.
